KT-01.2:
To renew the Merit Excellence Scholarship each year, you must maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher and complete at least 24 credits in the academic year. Renewal is reviewed automatically in June; no application is required.

Source: [Merit Excellence Scholarship – Renewal Requirements](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDXQA2/view) (Article 000001004)

KT-02.1:
To renew the Graduate Research Scholarship, you must submit an annual progress report signed by your research advisor. The report is due by 30 April each year. There is no GPA threshold for renewal of this scholarship.

Source: [Graduate Research Scholarship – Renewal Requirements](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDYQA2/view) (Article 000001006)

International students applying for the International Student Scholarship must provide the following documents: a valid passport, proof of English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 or higher), and a financial statement showing how remaining costs will be covered.

Source: [International Student Scholarship – Required Documents](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDbQAM/view) (Article 000001001)

KT-07.0:
Undergraduate students are eligible for the Need-Based Opportunity Grant if they submit the FAFSA and their family income is up to $60,000 a year. There is no GPA threshold. The grant is reassessed each year based on the new FAFSA.

Source: [Need-Based Opportunity Grant – Eligibility](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDWQA2/view) (Article 000001000)
